G2384.strongs: Jacob (i.e. Ja`akob), the progenitor of the Israelites
senses: The patriarch: [[r:MAT.1.2|Mat 1:2 8:11]], [[r:JHN.4.5|Jhn 4:5-6]], [[r:ACT.7.8|Act 7:8]], al; as in Heb. (cf. [[r:NUM.23.7|Num 23:7]], [[r:ISA.41.8|Isa 41:8]], [[r:SIR.23.12|Sir 23:12]], al.), of his descendants, [[r:ROM.11.26|Rom 11:26]] (LXX).
The father-in-law of Mary: [[r:MAT.1.15|Mat 1:15-16]] (on the form as distinct from that of the next word, see Deiss., BS, 3161) (AS)

G2309.forms: θέλω (the strengthened form ἐθέλω is found in Hom., and is the more frequently in Attic; see Rutherford, NPhr., 415f.)
G2309.root: apparently strengthened from the alternate form of [[w:G0138]]
G2309.strongs: to determine (as an active option from subjective impulse; whereas properly denotes rather a passive acquiescence in objective considerations), i.e. choose or prefer (literally or figuratively); by implication, to wish, i.e. be inclined to (sometimes adverbially, gladly); impersonally for the future tense, to be about to; by Hebraism, to delight in
G2309.kjv: desire, be disposed (forward), intend, list, love, mean, please, have rather, (be) will (have, -ling, - ling(-ly))
senses: to will, be willing, wish, desire (more frequently than βούλομαι, which see, in vernac. and late Gk., also in MGr.; for various views as to its relation to β., see Thayer, 286; but see also BL, §24, see word): absol., [[r:ROM.9.16|Rom 9:16]], [[r:1CO.4.19|1Co 4:19 12:18]], [[r:JAS.4.15|Jas 4:15]]; οὐ θέλω, [[r:MAT.18.30|Mat 18:30]], al.; id. with inf., [[r:MAT.2.18|Mat 2:18]], [[r:MRK.6.26|Mrk 6:26]], [[r:JHN.5.40|Jhn 5:40]], [[r:1CO.16.7|1Co 16:7]]; before ἵνα, [[r:MAT.7.12|Mat 7:12]], [[r:MRK.6.25|Mrk 6:25]], [[r:JHN.17.24|Jhn 17:24]]; opposite to ποιέω, πράσσω, ἐνεργέω, [[r:ROM.7.15|Rom 7:15, 19]] [[r:2CO.8.10|2Co 8:10, 11]] [[r:PHP.2.13|Php 2:13]]; before ἤ (ICG, in l.; Deiss., LAE, 179:24), [[r:1CO.14.19|1Co 14:19]]; θέλων ἐν ταπεινοφροσυνῄ (of his own mere will, by humility, R, mg), [[r:COL.2.18|Col 2:18]]; id. with inf., [[r:MAT.2.18|Mat 2:18]], [[r:MRK.6.26|Mrk 6:26]], [[r:JHN.5.40|Jhn 5:40]], [[r:1CO.16.7|1Co 16:7]]; before ἵνα, [[r:MAT.7.12|Mat 7:12]], [[r:MRK.6.25|Mrk 6:25]], [[r:JHN.17.24|Jhn 17:24]]; opposite to ποιέω, πράσσω, ἐνεργέω, [[r:ROM.7.15|Rom 7:15, 19]] [[r:2CO.8.10|2Co 8:10, 11]] [[r:PHP.2.13|Php 2:13]]; before ἤ (ICG, in l.; Deiss., LAE, 179:24), [[r:1CO.14.19|1Co 14:19]]; θέλων ἐν ταπεινοφροσυνῄ (of his own mere will, by humility, R, mg), [[r:COL.2.18|Col 2:18]]; G2316.forms: θεός, -οῦ, ὁ, ἡ ([[r:ACT.19.37|Act 19:37]] only; see M, Pr., 60, 244), late voc., θεέ ([[r:MAT.27.46|Mat 27:46]]; cf. [[r:DEU.3.24|Deu 3:24]], al.)
G2316.root: of uncertain affinity; a deity, especially (with [[w:G3588]]) the supreme Divinity
G2316.strongs: figuratively, a magistrate; by Hebraism, very
senses: In polytheistic sense, a god or deity: [[r:ACT.28.6|Act 28:6]], [[r:1CO.8.4|1Co 8:4]], [[r:2TH.2.4|2Th 2:4]], al.; pl., [[r:ACT.14.11|Ac 14:11 19:26]], [[r:GAL.4.8|Gal 4:8]], al.

anarthrous: [[r:MAT.6.24|Mat 6:24]], [[r:LUK.20.38|Luk 20:38]], al.; esp. with prep. (Kühner 3, iii, 605), ἀπὸ θ., [[r:JHN.3.2|Jhn 3:2]]; ἐκ, [[r:ACT.5.39|Act 5:39]], [[r:2CO.5.1|2Co 5:1]], [[r:PHP.3.9|Php 3:9]]; ὑπό, [[r:ROM.13.1|Rom 13:1]]; παρὰ θεοῦ, [[r:JHN.1.6|Jhn 1:6]]; παρὰ θεῷ, [[r:2TH.1.6|2Th 1:6]], [[r:1PE.2.4|1Pe 2:4]]; κατὰ θεόν, [[r:ROM.8.27|Rom 8:27]], [[r:2CO.7.9|2Co 7:9, 10]]; also when in genitive dependent on an anarth. noun (Bl., §46, 6), [[r:MAT.27.43|Mat 27:43]], [[r:LUK.3.2|Luk 3:2]], [[r:ROM.1.17|Rom 1:17]], [[r:1TH.2.13|1Th 2:13]]; as pred., [[r:LUK.20.38|Lk 20:38]], [[r:JHN.1.1|Jhn 1:1]], and when the nature and character rather than the person of God is meant, [[r:ACT.5.29|Act 5:29]], [[r:GAL.2.6|Gal 2:6]], al. (M, Th., 14);

more freq., with art.: [[r:MAT.1.23|Mat 1:23]], [[r:MRK.2.7|Mrk 2:7]], al. mult.; with prep., ἀπὸ τ. θ., [[r:LUK.1.26|Luk 1:26]]; ἐκ, [[r:JHN.8.42|Jhn 8:42]], al.; παρὰ τοῦ θ., [[r:JHN.8.40|Jhn 8:40]]; π. τῷ θ., [[r:ROM.9.14|Rom 9:14]]; ἐν, [[r:COL.3.3|Col 3:3]]; ἐπὶ τῷ θ., [[r:LUK.1.47|Luk 1:47]]; ἐπὶ τὸν θ., [[r:ACT.15.19|Act 15:19]]; εἰς τ. θ., [[r:ACT.24.15|Act 24:15]]; πρὸς τ. θ., [[r:JHN.1.2|Jhn 1:2]]; with genitive of person(s), [[r:MAT.22.32|Mat 22:32]], [[r:MRK.12.26|Mrk 12:26, 27]], Luk 20:37, [[r:JHN.20.17|Jhn 20:17]], al.; ὁ θ. μου, [[r:ROM.1.8|Rom 1:8]], [[r:PHP.1.3|Php 1:3]], al.; ὁ θ. καὶ πατήρ κ. τ. λ., [[r:ROM.15.6|Rom 15:6]], [[r:EPH.1.3|Eph 1:3]], [[r:PHP.4.20|Phi 4:20]], al.; with genitive of thing(s), [[r:ROM.15.5|Rom 15:5, 13, 33]], [[r:2CO.1.3|2Co 1:3]], [[r:1TH.5.23|1Th 5:23]]; τὰ τ. θεοῦ, [[r:MAT.16.23|Mat 16:23]], [[r:MRK.12.17|Mrk 12:17]], [[r:1CO.2.11|1Co 2:11]]; τὰ πρὸς τὸν θ., [[r:ROM.15.17|Rom 15:17]], [[r:HEB.2.17|Heb 2:17 5:1]]; τ. θεῷ, as a superl. (LXX, [[r:JOS.3.3|Jos 3:3]]), [[r:ACT.7.20|Act 7:20]], [[r:2CO.10.4|2Co 10:4]]; Hebraistically, of judges (Psa.81(82):6), [[r:JHN.10.34|Jhn 10:34]]" (LXX), 35. (AS)

G2344.strongs: a deposit, i.e. wealth (literally or figuratively)
senses: a treasury ([[r:1MA.3.29|1Ma 3:29]] and frequently in cl.); (with) a storehouse ([[r:NEH.13.12|Neh 13:12]], [[r:DEU.28.12|Deu 28:12]], al.): [[r:MAT.13.52|Mat 13:52]]; metaphorically, of the soul, [[r:MAT.12.35|Mat 12:35]]; τ. καρδίας, [[r:LUK.6.45|Luk 6:45]]

a treasure: [[r:MAT.6.18|Mat 6:18-21 13:44]], [[r:LUK.12.33|Luk 12:33-34]], [[r:HEB.11.26|Heb 11:26]]; θ. ἐν οὐρανῷ (see Dalman, Words, 206 ff.), [[r:MAT.19.21|Mat 19:21]], [[r:MRK.10.21|Mrk 10:21]], [[r:LUK.18.22|Luk 18:22]]; of the knowledge of God through Christ, [[r:2CO.4.7|2Co 4:7]]; τ. σοφίας κ. γνώσεως, [[r:COL.2.3|Col 2:3.]]† (AS)

G2373.strongs: to put in a passion, i.e. enrage
senses: (θυμός) (no act. in Attic.); pass. (and mid.), to be wroth or very angry: [[r:MAT.2.16|Mat 2:16.]]† (AS)

G2348.root: a strengthened form of a simpler primary θάνω (which is used for it only in certain tenses)
senses: θνήσκω to die; pf. (M, Pr., 114), to be dead: [[r:MAT.2.20|Mat 2:20]], [[r:MRK.15.44|Mrk 15:44]], [[r:LUK.7.12|Luk 7:12 8:49]], [[r:JHN.11.44|Jhn 11:44 19:33]], [[r:ACT.14.19|Act 14:19 25:19]]; metaphorically, of spiritual death, [[r:1TI.5.6|1Ti 5:6]] (cf. ἀπο-, συν-απο-θνήσκω).† (AS)

G2385.strongs: Jacobus, the name of three Israelites
senses: Son of Alphæus: [[r:MAT.10.3|Mat 10:3]], [[r:MRK.2.14|Mrk 2:14]], al.; commonly identified with Ἰ. ὁ μικρός, James the little, son of Mary (see: Μαρία, 3; Κλωπᾶς), [[r:MAT.27.56|Mat 27:56]], [[r:MRK.15.40|Mrk 15:40 16:1]] (cf. [[r:JHN.19.25|Jhn 19:25]]).
The father of the apostle, Ἰούδας Ἰακώβου: [[r:LUK.6.16|Luk 6:16]], [[r:ACT.1.13|Act 1:13]] (AS)

G2323.strongs: to wait upon menially, i.e. (figuratively) to adore (God), or (specially) to relieve (of disease)
senses: to do service, serve: with accusative of person(s), pass., [[r:ACT.17.25|Act 17:25.]]

As medical term, to treat (MM, Exp., xv), cure, heal: [[r:MAT.12.10|Mat 12:10]], [[r:MRK.6.5|Mrk 6:5]], [[r:LUK.6.7|Luk 6:7]], al.; with accusative of person(s), [[r:MAT.4.24|Mat 4:24]], [[r:MRK.1.34|Mrk 1:34]], al.; before ἀπό, [[r:LUK.5.15|Luk 5:15 6:18 7:21 8:2, 43]]; θ. νόσον (μαλακίαν), [[r:MAT.4.23|Mat 4:23]], al SYN: ἰάομαι (see Field, Notes, 60; MM, Exp., l.with) (AS)

G2379.strongs: a place of sacrifice, i.e. an altar (special or genitive case, literal or figurative)
senses: generally, [[r:JAS.2.21|Jas 2:21]]; pl., [[r:ROM.11.3|Rom 11:3]] (LXX); metaphorically, [[r:HEB.13.10|Heb 13:10]] (see Westc., in l, and esp. his add, note on the history of the word, 455 ff.);

of the altar of burnt-offering in the Temple, [[r:MAT.5.23|Mat 5:23-24 23:18-20, 35]], [[r:LUK.11.51|Luk 11:51]], [[r:1CO.9.13|1Co 9:13 10:18]], [[r:HEB.7.13|Heb 7:13]], [[r:REV.11.1|Rev 11:1]]; (with) of the altar of incense in the sanctuary ([[r:EXO.30.1|Exo 30:1]], al.), [[r:LUK.1.11|Luk 1:11]]; symbolically in Heaven, [[r:REV.6.9|Rev 6:9 8:3 9:13 14:18 16:7]] (Cremer, 292).† (AS)

G2362.strongs: a stately seat ("throne"); by implication, power or (concretely) a potentate
senses: in Hom., a seat, chair. Later, a throne, chair of state, seat of authority; of kings: metaphorically, of God, [[r:MAT.5.34|Mat 5:34]], [[r:ACT.7.49|Act 7:49]]" (LXX), [[r:REV.1.4|Rev 1:4]], al.; by meton., for kingly power, sovereignty, [[r:LUK.1.32|Luk 1:32, 52]], [[r:ACT.2.30|Act 2:30]]; for an angelic hierarchy, [[r:COL.1.16|Col 1:16]]; of Christ, [[r:MAT.19.28|Mat 19:28]], [[r:REV.3.21|Rev 3:21]], al.; of Satan, [[r:REV.2.13|Rev 2:13]]; τ. θηρίου, [[r:REV.16.10|Rev 16:10]]; of the Apostles, [[r:MAT.19.28|Mat 19:28]], [[r:LUK.22.30|Luk 22:30]], cf. [[r:REV.20.4|Rev 20:4]]; of πρεσβύτεροι, [[r:REV.4.4|Rev 4:4 11:16]] (on θ. τῆς χάριτος, [[r:HEB.4.16|Heb 4:16]], see Westc., in l; Deiss., BS, 135) (AS)

G2300.root: a prolonged form of a primary verb
G2300.strongs: to look closely at, i.e. (by implication) perceive (literally or figuratively); by extension to visit
senses: to behold, look upon, contemplate, view (in early writers with a sense of wondering), in NT apparently always in literal, physical sense of "careful and deliberate vision which interprets... its object": with accusative of thing(s), [[r:MAT.11.7|Mat 11:7]], [[r:LUK.7.24|Luk 7:24 23:55]], [[r:JHN.1.14|Jhn 1:14, 32 4:35 11:45]], [[r:ACT.22.9|Act 22:9]], [[r:1JN.1.1|1Jn 1:1]]; with accusative of person(s), [[r:MAT.22.11|Mat 22:11]], [[r:ACT.21.27|Act 21:27]], [[r:ROM.15.24|Rom 15:24]], [[r:1JN.4.12|1Jn 4:12]]; with ptcp., [[r:MRK.16.14|Mrk 16:14]], [[r:LUK.5.27|Luk 5:27]], [[r:JHN.1.38|Jhn 1:38]], [[r:ACT.1.11|Act 1:11]]; before ὅτι, [[r:JHN.6.5|Jhn 6:5]], [[r:1JN.4.14|1Jn 4:14]]; pass., [[r:MAT.6.1|Mat 6:1 23:5]], [[r:MRK.16.11|Mrk 16:11]].† SYN.: see: θεωρέω (AS)

G2374.strongs: a portal or entrance (the opening or the closure, literally or figuratively)
senses: a door: κλείειν (ἀποκ-) τὴν θ., [[r:MAT.6.6|Mat 6:6]], [[r:LUK.13.25|Luk 13:25]]; pass., [[r:MAT.25.10|Mat 25:10]], [[r:LUK.11.7|Luk 11:7]], [[r:JHN.20.19|Jhn 20:19, 26]], [[r:ACT.21.30|Act 21:30]]; ἀνοίγειν, [[r:ACT.5.19|Act 5:19]]; pass., [[r:ACT.16.26|Act 16:26-27]]; κρούειν, [[r:ACT.12.13|Act 12:13]]; διὰ τῆς θ., [[r:JHN.10.1|Jhn 10:1-2]]; πρὸς τὴν θ., [[r:MRK.1.33|Mrk 1:33 11:4]] (WH om. τήν), [[r:ACT.3.2|Act 3:2]]; τὰ πρὸς τὴν θ., the space by the door, [[r:MRK.2.2|Mrk 2:2]]; πρὸς τῇ θ., [[r:JHN.18.16|Jhn 18:16]]; ἐπὶ τῇ θ, [[r:ACT.5.9|Act 5:9]]; πρὸ τῆς θ., [[r:ACT.12.6|Act 12:6]]; ἐπὶ τῶν θ., [[r:ACT.5.23|Act 5:23]]; ἡ θ. τ. μνημείου, [[r:MAT.27.60|Mat 27:60]], [[r:MRK.15.46|Mrk 15:46 16:3]]. Metaphorical, of Christ, ἡ θ. τ. προβάτων, [[r:JHN.10.7|Jhn 10:7]], 9; of the Kingdom of Heaven, [[r:LUK.13.24|Luk 13:24]]; of opportunities, θ. πίστεως, [[r:ACT.14.27|Act 14:27]]; θ. μεγάλη, [[r:1CO.16.9|1Co 16:9]]; θ. τ. λόγου, [[r:COL.4.3|Col 4:3]]; θ. ἀνεῳγμένη (ἠνεῳγ-), [[r:2CO.2.12|2Co 2:12]], [[r:REV.3.8|Rev 3:8 4:1]]; of Christ, ἑστηκὼς ἐπὶ τὴν θ. καὶ κρούων, [[r:REV.3.20|Rev 3:20]]; of his second coming, ἐπὶ θύραις εἶναι, [[r:MAT.24.33|Mat 24:33]], [[r:MRK.13.29|Mrk 13:29]]; πρὸ θυρῶν ἑστηκέναι, [[r:JAS.5.9|Jas 5:9.]]† (AS)

G2307.strongs: a determination (properly, the thing), i.e. (actively) choice (specially, purpose, decree; abstractly, volition) or (passively) inclination
senses: objectively = that which is willed: [[r:MAT.18.14|Mat 18:14]], [[r:LUK.12.47|Luk 12:47]], [[r:JHN.5.30|Jhn 5:30]], [[r:1CO.7.37|1Co 7:37]], [[r:1TH.5.18|1Th 5:18]], [[r:2TI.2.26|2Ti 2:26]], [[r:HEB.10.10|Heb 10:10]], [[r:REV.4.11|Rev 4:11]]; θ. τ. θεοῦ, [[r:ACT.22.14|Act 22:14]], [[r:ROM.2.18|Rom 2:18 12:2]], [[r:EPH.1.9|Eph 1:9]], [[r:COL.1.9|Col 1:9 4:12]], [[r:1PE.4.2|1Pe 4:2]]; τ. κυρίου, [[r:EPH.5.17|Eph 5:17]]; pl., of precepts, [[r:MRK.3.35|Mrk 3:35]], WH, mg., [[r:ACT.13.22|Act 13:22]] (LXX); ἐστιν τὸ θ., with genitive of person(s), before ἵνα, [[r:JHN.6.39|Jhn 6:39-40]], [[r:1CO.16.12|1Co 16:12]]; with inf., [[r:1PE.2.15|1Pe 2:15]]; with accusative and inf., [[r:1TH.4.3|1Th 4:3]]

G2343.strongs: to amass or reserve (literally or figuratively)
G2343.kjv: lay up (treasure), (keep) in store, (heap) treasure (together, up)
senses: θησαυρίζω to lay up, store up: of riches, [[r:JAS.5.3|Jas 5:3]]; id. with dative of person(s), [[r:LUK.12.21|Luk 12:21]], [[r:2CO.12.14|2Co 12:14]]; with accusative of thing(s), [[r:1CO.16.2|1Co 16:2]]; θησαυροὺς ἑαυτῷ, [[r:MAT.6.19|Mat 6:19-20]]; pass., [[r:2PE.3.7|2Pe 3:7]]; metaphorically, ὀργὴν ἑαντῷ, [[r:ROM.2.5|Rom 2:5]] (cf. [[r:PRO.1.18|Pro 1:18]], Pss. [[r:PSS.9.9|Pss Sol 9:9]]).† (AS)

G2325.root: from [[w:G2330]] (in the sense of the crop)

G2346.kjv: afflict, narrow, throng, suffer tribulation, trouble
senses: θλίβω to press: with accusative of person(s), [[r:MRK.3.9|Mrk 3:9]]; ὁδὸς τεθλιμμένη, a narrow (compressed) way, [[r:MAT.7.14|Mat 7:14.]] Metaphorical (as frequently in LXX), to oppress, afflict, distress: with accusative of person(s), [[r:2TH.1.6|2Th 1:6]]; pass. (Vg., tribulor, tribulation em patior), [[r:2CO.1.6|2Co 1:6 4:8 7:5]], [[r:1TH.3.4|1Th 3:4]], [[r:2TH.1.7|2Th 1:7]], [[r:1TI.5.10|1Ti 5:10]], [[r:HEB.11.37|Heb 11:37]] (cf. ἀπο-, συν-θλίβω).† (AS)

G2311.strongs: to lay a basis for, i.e. (literally) erect, or (figuratively) consolidate
senses: to lay the foundation of, to found: with accusative, τ. γῆν, [[r:HEB.1.10|Heb 1:10]] (LXX); pass., [[r:MAT.7.25|Mat 7:25]], [[r:LUK.6.48|Luk 6:48]]; metaphorically, [[r:1PE.5.10|1Pe 5:10]] (R, mg., settle); pass., [[r:EPH.3.18|Eph 3:18]], [[r:COL.1.23|Col 1:23]].† (AS)

G2390.root: middle voice of apparently a primary verb

G2398.strongs: pertaining to self, i.e. one's own; by implication, private or separate
G2398.kjv: X his acquaintance, when they were alone, apart, aside, due, his (own, proper, several), home, (her, our, thine, your) own (business), private(-ly), proper, severally, their (own)
senses: of that which is private and personal (in cl. opposite to κοινός, δημόσιος; cf. infr. 3);

of property, friends, home, country, etc. (in cl. opposite to ἀλλότριος; in late writers often, like ἑαυτοῦ, with weakened sense, see M, Pr., 87ff.; Deiss., BS, 123f.): [[r:LUK.6.41|Luk 6:41]], [[r:JHN.1.42|Jhn 1:42 5:43]], [[r:ACT.2.6|Act 2:6 20:28]], [[r:1CO.11.21|1Co 11:21]], [[r:GAL.6.5|Gal 6:5]], [[r:2TI.1.9|2Ti 1:9]], [[r:HEB.7.27|Heb 7:27]], Ju 6, al.; πράσσειν τὰ ἴ., [[r:1TH.4.11|1Th 4:11]]; κατὰ τὰς ἰ. ἐπιθυμίας, [[r:2TI.4.3|2Ti 4:3]]; οἱ ἴδιοι, [[r:JHN.1.11|Jhn 1:11]] (M, Pr., 90f.; Field, Notes, 84) 13:1, [[r:ACT.4.23|Act 4:23]], [[r:1TI.5.8|1Ti 5:8]]; τὰ ἴδια, one's home (Field, Notes, l.with), [[r:LUK.18.28|Luk 18:28]], [[r:JHN.1.11|Jhn 1:11 16:32 19:27]].

peculiar, distinct, appropriate, proper: τὸ ἴ. σῶμα, [[r:1CO.15.38|1Co 15:38]]; ἐν τ. ἰ. τάγματι, [[r:1CO.15.23|1Co 15:23]]; εἰς τ. τόπον τ. ἴ., [[r:ACT.1.25|Act 1:25]]; = αὐτοῦ (see Deiss., ut. supr.), [[r:MAT.22.5|Mat 22:5]], [[r:JHN.1.42|Jhn 1:42]] (cf. [[r:WIS.10.1|Wis 10:1]]).
κατ᾽ ἰδίαν, apart, privately, in private: [[r:MAT.14.13|Mat 14:13, 23 20:17]], [[r:MRK.4.34|Mrk 4:34 7:33]], [[r:LUK.10.23|Luk 10:23]], [[r:ACT.23.19|Act 23:19]], al. (AS)

G2364.strongs: a female child, or (by Hebraism) descendant (or inhabitant)
senses: as a form of friendly address (cf. [[r:RUT.2.2|Rut 2:2, 22]] al.): [[r:MAT.9.22|Mat 9:22]], [[r:MRK.5.34|Mrk 5:34]], [[r:LUK.8.48|Luk 8:48]];

metaphorically: sc. κυρίου, [[r:2CO.6.18|2Co 6:18]] (cf. [[r:ISA.43.6|Isa 43:6]]); (with) of posterity: θ. Ἀαρών, [[r:LUK.1.5|Luk 1:5]]; Ἀβραάμ, [[r:LUK.13.16|Luk 13:16]] (cf. [[r:ISA.16.2|Isa 16:2]], 4Ma.15:28, al);

senses: to make a noise or uproar: mid., of loud and ostentatious lamentation, [[r:MAT.9.23|Mat 9:23]], [[r:MRK.5.39|Mrk 5:39]], [[r:ACT.20.10|Act 20:10]].
Trans., to trouble, throw into confusion: τ. πόλιν, [[r:ACT.17.5|Act 17:5.]]† (AS)

θωμᾶς, -ᾶ, ὁ (Heb.: תָּאוֹם, a twin; cf. δίδυμος), Thomas the Apostle: [[r:MAT.10.3|Mat 10:3]], [[r:MRK.3.18|Mrk 3:18]], [[r:LUK.6.15|Luk 6:15]], [[r:JHN.11.16|Jhn 11:16 14:5 20:24-28 21:2]], [[r:ACT.1.13|Act 1:13]].† (AS)
Trans., to bewail: with accusative of person(s), [[r:LUK.23.27|Luk 23:27.]]† SYN.: κλαίω, κόπτομαι, λυπέομαι, πενθέω (see Tr., Syn., lxv). (AS)

senses: θλίψις (LTr., θλῖψις), -εως, ἡ (θλίβω), pressure (Arist.). Χριστοῦ, [[r:COL.1.24|Col 1:24]]; θ. τῆς καρδίας, [[r:2CO.2.4|2Co 2:4]]; θ. ἐγείρειν, [[r:PHP.1.17|Php 1:17.]]† SYN.: ἀνάγκη, διωγμός, στενοχωρία (see supr., and cf. Tr., Syn, iv; Lft., Notes, 45) (AS)
female: as subst., ἡ θ., a female, a woman: [[r:ROM.1.26|Rom 1:26-27]]; τὸ θ.., [[r:MAT.19.4|Mat 19:4]], [[r:MRK.10.6|Mrk 10:6]], [[r:GAL.3.28|Gal 3:28]].† (AS)
Of the young, to suck: [[r:MAT.21.16|Mat 21:16]]; μαστούς, [[r:LUK.11.27|Luk 11:27]] (cf. [[r:JOB.3.12|Job 3:12]], [[r:SNG.8.1|Sng 8:1]], al.).† (AS)

G2380.strongs: properly, to rush (breathe hard, blow, smoke), i.e. (by implication) to sacrifice (properly, by fire, but genitive case); by extension to immolate (slaughter for any purpose)
senses: to offer first fruits to a god.
to sacrifice by slaying a victim, offer sacrifice: [[r:ACT.14.13|Act 14:13]]; with dative of person(s), [[r:ACT.14.18|Act 14:18]]; id. with accusative of thing(s), [[r:1CO.10.20|1Co 10:20.]]

G2360.strongs: to clamor, i.e. (by implication) to frighten
senses: to cry aloud, make an outcry.
In NT (and LXX), pass., to be troubled, as by an alarm: [[r:MAT.24.6|Mat 24:6]], [[r:MRK.13.7|Mrk 13:7]], [[r:LUK.24.37|Luk 24:37]] (WH, mg.), [[r:2TH.2.2|2Th 2:2]] (cf. Kennedy, Sources, 126).† (AS)

a noise, uproar, tumult, as of an excited mob: [[r:MAT.26.5|Mat 26:5 27:24]], [[r:MRK.14.2|Mrk 14:2]], [[r:ACT.20.1|Act 20:1 21:34 24:18]]; of mourners, = ὄχλος θορυβούμενος, [[r:MRK.5.38|Mrk 5:38.]]† (AS)

G2334.root: from a derivative of [[w:G2300]] (perhaps by addition of [[w:G3708]])
G2334.strongs: to be a spectator of, i.e. discern, (literally, figuratively (experience) or intensively (acknowledge))
G2334.kjv: behold, consider, look on, perceive, see
senses: (θεωρός, a spectator, θεάομαι) (present and imperfect only, exc. [[r:JHN.7.3|Jhn 7:3]] (fut.), [[r:MAT.28.1|Mat 28:1]], [[r:LUK.23.48|Luk 23:48]], [[r:JHN.8.51|Jhn 8:51]], [[r:REV.11.12|Rev 11:12]] (aor.); El., § 24);

In popular lang. (Kennedy, Sources, 155; EL, § 24, see word ὁρᾶν), in present and imperfect = ὁράω, to see, perceive, discern: before ὅτι, [[r:MRK.16.4|Mrk 16:4]], [[r:JHN.4.19|Jhn 4:19 12:19]], [[r:ACT.19.26|Act 19:26 27:10]]; πόσαι, [[r:ACT.21.20|Act 21:20]]; πηλίκος, [[r:HEB.7.4|Heb 7:4]]; with accusative of thing(s), [[r:MRK.5.38|Mrk 5:38]]; id. with ptcp., [[r:ACT.17.16|Act 17:16 28:6]]; with accusative of person(s), [[r:MRK.3.11|Mrk 3:11]], [[r:JHN.14.19|Jhn 14:19]], [[r:ACT.9.7|Act 9:7 17:22]]; πνεῦμα, [[r:LUK.24.37|Luk 24:37]]; τὸ π., [[r:JHN.14.17|Jhn 14:17]]; before ὅτι, [[r:JHN.9.8|Jhn 9:8]]; with ptcp., [[r:LUK.24.39|Luk 24:39.]]
Hebraistically, to experience, partake of: τ. θάνατον, [[r:JHN.8.51|Jhn 8:51]] (cf. [[r:PSA.89.49|Psa 89:49]]); τ. δόξαν, [[r:JHN.17.24|Jhn 17:24]] (cf. ἀνα-, παρα-θερρέω).† (AS)
εἰδέα (Rec. ἰδ-, as in cl.; see Tdf., Pr., 81), -ας, ἡ (εἶδον), appearance, look: [[r:MAT.28.3|Mat 28:3.]]† (AS)

= θεώρημα, a spectacle, sight: [[r:LUK.23.48|Luk 23:48]] (both senses in cl.).† (AS)
a nurseling, esp. of animals (Eur., Plat., al.).

one without professional knowledge, unskilled, uneducated, unlearned: [[r:1CO.14.16|1Co 14:16 14:23-24]] (R, mg., without gifts); ἀγράμματοι κ. ἰ., [[r:ACT.4.13|Act 4:13]]; with dative (= cl. with genitive of thing(s)), λόγῳ, [[r:2CO.11.6|2Co 11:6.]]† (AS)
(perh. contr. from Θεόδωρος, but see MM, Exp., xv), -ᾶ, ὁ Theudas: [[r:ACT.5.36|Act 5:36.]]† (AS)

Collective for οἱ θεαταί, the spectators.
= θέα, θέαμα, a spectacle, show: metaphorically, [[r:1CO.4.9|1Co 4:9.]]† (AS)

senses: (θρῆσκος), religion in its external aspect (MM, Exp., xv), worship: [[r:ACT.26.5|Act 26:5]], [[r:JAS.1.26|Jas 1:26-27]]; θ. τῶν ἀγγέλων, [[r:COL.2.18|Col 2:18.]]† SYN.: see: θρῆσκος (AS)

(θεῖος) divine nature, divinity: [[r:ROM.1.20|Rom 1:20]] (for ex. from π., see MM, Exp., xv).† SYN.: θεότης, deity, godhead, divine personality. θει. = divine nature and properties, a summary term for the attributes of deity, differing from θεότης as quality or attribute from essence (AS)
passive, as frequently in cl., hateful to God: [[r:ROM.1.30|Rom 1:30]] (R, txt., cf. Lit., Notes, 256).
Active, hating God: lb. (R, mg., cf. ICC, in l).† (AS)

most frequently in cl., a means of healing, remedy (Thuc., al.; [[r:WIS.11.4|Wis 11:4 10:9]]).
= ἴασις (which see), a healing (Plat.; Jer, l.with): pl., [[r:1CO.12.9|1Co 12:9 12:28 12:30]].† (AS)

senses: (θηρίον, μάχομαι), to fight with wild beasts (Diod., al.): [[r:1CO.15.32|1Co 15:32.]]† (AS)

G2358.strongs: and a derivative of (meaning a noisy iambus, sung in honor of Bacchus); to make an acclamatory procession, i.e. (figuratively) to conquer or (by Hebraism) to give victory
senses: (θρίαμβος, 1. a festal hymn to Bacchus. 2. The Roman triumphus),
to triumph (and rarely, with accusative, to triumph over; so perh. [[r:COL.2.15|Col 2:15]], but see infr.).

to lead in triumph: with accusative of person(s), [[r:2CO.2.14|2Co 2:14]]; hence, generally, to make a spectacle or show of: [[r:COL.2.15|Col 2:15]] (but see supr.; cf. MM, Exp., xv; and esp. Field, Notes, 181).† (AS)

G2382.strongs: the chest ("thorax"), i.e. (by implication) a corslet
senses: a breastplate: [[r:REV.9.9|Rev 9:9, 17]]; θ. τ. δικαιοσύνης, [[r:EPH.6.14|Eph 6:14]] (cf. [[r:ISA.59.17|Isa 59:17]], [[r:WIS.5.18|Wis 5:18-19]]); θ. πίστεως, [[r:1TH.5.8|1Th 5:8.]]† (AS)

G2345.strongs: to manipulate, i.e. have to do with; by implication, to injure
senses: to injure (like Heb. נָגַע, and as in Eur., Iph. Aul., 1351): with genitive, [[r:HEB.11.28|Heb 11:28.]]† SYN.: see: ἅπτω (AS)

G2315.root: from [[w:G2316]] and a presumed derivative of [[w:G4154]]

senses: (θέλω) in colloq. and MGr. = τὸ θέλειν, will: [[r:HEB.2.4|Heb 2:4.]]† (AS)

G2324.root: apparently a participle from an otherwise obsolete derivative of the base of [[w:G2330]]

senses: as in cl. (Hdt., iv, 162; Thuc., vi, 46) and LXX, a censer: [[r:HEB.9.4|Heb 9:4]] (but see infr., and cf. Westc., in l).
As in Philo., rer. div., § 46, FlJ, Ant., iv, 2, 4, al., the altar of incense: He, l.with (but see supr. and cf. MM, Exp., xv).† (AS)
(θέατρον), to make a spectacle of, expose to contempt (eccl.; ἐκθ-, Polyb.): pass., [[r:HEB.10.33|Heb 10:33.]]† (AS)

senses: (θύω), (poët. in cl.), a hurricane, cyclone, whirlwind: [[r:HEB.12.18|Heb 12:18.]]† SYN.: λαίλαψ (which see) (AS)

G2357.strongs: ceremonious in worship (as demonstrative), i.e. pious
senses: θρῆσκος (-κός, WH), -ον, ό religious, careful of the outward forms of divine service (see previous word)): [[r:JAS.1.26|Jas 1:26.]]† SYN.: εὐσεβής, θεοσεβής, δεισιδαίμων (see Tr., Syn., § xlviii) (AS)
jasper, apparently not the modern stone of that name, but a translucent stone (DB, see word): [[r:REV.4.3|Rev 4:3 21:11, 18-19]].† (AS)
